quizzes.question: A draft OPL covers connector insertion, screw torque, label checks and ESD on one page. What's the problem?
options: It has too many points — split it into separate OPLs
It should be in color only
quizzes.explanation: An OPL teaches ONE point. Four topics on one page dilute the message — make four focused OPLs instead.

quizzes.question: Everyone signed the OPL two weeks ago, but the same defect is back. What should the supervisor do FIRST?
options: Observe the work and check the standard, method and lesson
Remove the OPL from the line
quizzes.explanation: Signatures don't prove learning. Go and observe: is the method followed, is the standard right, is the OPL clear? Then fix the cause.
